Append a Tamper-Evident Entry to an Immutable JSONL Audit Log

Source: R/audit.R
audit_log_append.Rd

Writes a cryptographically hash-chained audit record (prev_hash -> entry_hash) to a JSONL audit log file. Enforces strict zero-PII-leakage invariants by rejecting raw text keys, undeclared top-level fields, non-integer PII summaries, and any metadata strings containing detectable PII.

Usage

audit_log_append(
  path,
  entry,
  event_type = "extraction_run",
  metadata = NULL,
  verify_existing = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

Character scalar path to the JSONL audit log file.

entry

An airgap_extraction result, airgap_run_manifest, airgap_preflight, airgap_digest_verification, or validated named list matching the v1.0 audit schema.

event_type

Character scalar event label (default "extraction_run").

metadata

Optional named list of non-sensitive study metadata (e.g., list(irb_protocol = "IRB-2026-0412", site = "Site-A")). Scanned for PII and length-capped at 256 characters per string.

verify_existing

Logical scalar; if TRUE (default) and path already exists, verifies the existing hash chain via audit_log_verify() before appending.

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_audit_entry" representing the appended record (including seq, prev_hash, and entry_hash).

Examples

tmp_log <- tempfile(fileext = ".jsonl")
df <- tibble::tibble(id = "R1", text = "Patient John Doe emailed john@clinic.org.")
sc <- extraction_schema(flag = schema_field("logical"))
res <- airgap_extract(df, "text", sc, runtime_mock(), id_col = "id")
entry <- audit_log_append(tmp_log, res)
audit_log_verify(tmp_log)
#> <airgap_audit_verification> [VALID]
#>   Entries verified: 1
#>   Chain head hash:  sha256:bb9a91a1c2f4182d5a5844a6ead3bce03516a315af22c15d3557d4fdd53db88c
unlink(tmp_log)
